params.body:
Docs only. A widening approved by passkey now falls inside the owner's working set (portal and elixir PRs on `workbench/repair-in-working-set`).

- `docs/working-set.md`: *A widening by passkey* replaces its "Not yet" paragraph with the rule as built. The note that the passkey inside a working set was "still open" now says it is built for repairs and what it rests on.
- `conformance/statement.md`: the disclosed gap says Portal is also trusted for the working-set check, and keeps the assertion and the set beside the version.

No code changes, so no release is needed. `go vet ./...` and `go test ./...` pass.
params.title: Working set: a repair by passkey falls inside the set, as built
